newsitem.title: USA: U.S. consumer group's annual hazardous toy list.
newsitem.headline: U.S. consumer group's annual hazardous toy list.

text.p: The following is U.S. Public Interest Research Group's 11th annual "Trouble In Toyland" list of hazardous toys and toys that contain small parts with a diameter under 1.25 inches.
1. Puppy Play House, Talentoy (China). A battery-operated dog picks up puppies and places them on a roller coaster. The puppies are a choking hazard.
2. Disney's 101 Dalmatian's Puppy Pal, ArcoToys Inc. (Mattel USA). Toy comes with a small ball and bottle that are a choking hazard.
3. Impact Racer, Zap/Lucky Quality Toys (China). Red truck towing purple racing car, though colours may vary. Child can choke on tires, which come off the racing car.

4. Soft 'N Snug Doll Care Accessories labeled for ages above 2, Geoffrey, Inc. distributed by Toys R Us. Empty baby bottles, pacifier, spoon, fork and cup. Nipples come off bottles and are a choking hazard.
5. Free Wheeling Dump Truck, unknown manufacturer (Hong Kong). Small parts pose choking hazard.
6. Baby-in-a-Bottle, unknown manufacturer (China). Nipple screws off bottle and poses choking hazard.
7. Nia Gift Set Dress-Me-Up Doll, Integrity Toys Inc. (USA). 12-inch doll has shoes and some accessories that pose choking hazard.
8. Balloons. "Animal and cartoon character balloons are attractive to very young children and should not be marketed," U.S. PIRG said.
9. Birthday Party Stamper Kit, The Rubber Stamp Factory (USA). Cartoon character stampers pose choking hazard.
10. Small Ball, unknown manufacturer (Taiwan). Small ball has a second ball floating with pictures of eyeballs or bugs and poses choking hazard.
11. Fun Novelty Erasers, unknown manufacturer (China). Brightly coloured erasers in shapes of fruits, animals, flowers, candy, or telephone pose choking hazard.
12. Wooden puzzles, Fraja (Germany). Three-dimensional puzzles of bears and fairy tale characters have some pieces that pose choking hazard.
13. Magic Capsules, Creative Discovery/TMC. Pill-size capsules contain compressed small sponge animals and pose choking hazard.
14. Lego System Trial Size Imagination, Lego Systems (USA). Toy from old stock does not warn of choking hazard to children under age 3.
15. National Basketball Association Squirt Balls, Pentech International Inc. (USA). Toy needs proper warning label for choking hazard.
16. Chunky Rescue Set, Shelcore Inc. (Britain). Toy does not violate the small parts regulation but the cone shape of pylons could become stuck in a child's throat and block the airway.
The following toys do not violate any U.S. Consumer Product Safety Commission regulation but U.S. PIRG found them to be potentially hazardous.
17. Soft Cow Pull Toy, Osh Kosh B'Gosh, Eden LLC (USA) Toy is labeled for age one but cord is 28 inches long and poses strangulation hazard.
18. Big Fun Chuffa Puffa train, Tomy. Pull cord is 39 inches long and poses strangulation hazard.
19. Little Snoopy, Fisher-Price Inc. (USA). Sold for ages 1-3 but pull cord is 27 inches long and poses strangulation hazard.
20. Catchin' Shark Game, unknown manufacturer (China). Pointed teeth could cut child.
21. Stomp Rocket, The D and L Co. Toy bears warning label against aiming at face or eyes and at others and pets. U.S. PIRG said the air-fired rocket can travel 400 feet and poses a projectile hazard.
